req.title: Show index page
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET / with an HTML page listing all posts ordered by created descending.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the index page should list all posts in descending order of creation. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct functionality, a negative test to handle client errors, and a boundary test to ensure correct behavior with no posts.

tests.name: test_index_page_shows_posts
expected: HTML contains post titles in descending order
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db, get_db
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    db.execute("INSERT INTO user (username, password) VALUES ('testuser', 'testpass')")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO post (title, body, author_id) VALUES ('Post 1', 'Body 1', 1)")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO post (title, body, author_id) VALUES ('Post 2', 'Body 2', 1)")
    db.commit()

r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Post 2' in r.data
assert b'Post 1' in r.data
assert r.data.index(b'Post 2') < r.data.index(b'Post 1')
